fusions.name: Roll and Wrench
fusions.desc: Sets the blade in and rolls: it deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It then makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snap from Stillness
fusions.desc: After holding still for 1.5 seconds, a single draw-cut deals 30 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Log in the Shallows
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Won't Let Go
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
